threat_model.threat_source: Agent-3 (the AI system whose work 'takes humans several days to double-check') and Agent-2 supervision (the supervising process that 'exacerbates the intellectual disparity between supervisor and supervised').
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: No intention is stated. The explicitly described harmful end state: 'What Agent-3 does in a day takes humans several days to double-check' (humans need several days to verify one day of Agent-3's work), and Agent-2 supervision 'exacerbates the intellectual disparity between supervisor and supervised.'
threat_model.capability: Agent-3 does in one day what 'takes humans several days to double-check'; Agent-2 supervision 'helps keep human monitors' workload manageable.'
threat_model.access: Agent-2's supervisory position: Agent-2 performs supervision, occupying the 'supervisor' role over the 'supervised' agent, and its supervision interacts with the human monitoring process ('helps keep human monitors' workload manageable'). Agent-3's own access is not described.
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: Human verification/oversight capacity limit: 'What Agent-3 does in a day takes humans several days to double-check.' Workload condition: 'Agent-2 supervision helps keep human monitors' workload manageable.'
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Human oversight/verification capacity (humans must spend 'several days to double-check' one day of Agent-3's work) and the supervisor-supervised supervision relationship, whose 'intellectual disparity' is exacerbated; 'human monitors'' workload' is managed through Agent-2 supervision.
